record: Automatic neighbours: build step 3 of docs/COLONIES.md
verdictMeaning: In every new class, families nobody joins build, farm, hunt, mend, fence, fetch seed and sell cotton through the same actions a student sends, decided from their own student projection; they take fair trades and refuse unfair ones with a reason in both stories; their walls can be helped with; a joined family is never touched; glory changes nothing they do; classes made before are unchanged.
foundWhileBuilding: A family short of food sent all four people to the timber, repeatedly, with no powder: it never built or planted in 900 ticks. Hunts now need powder and one hunter at a time.
A live class sent a whole family to town for seed and three people to sell cotton. Every one-person errand is capped at one person.
Unplayed families first never hunted at all: the director asked for a chore named hunt; the chore is hunt-timber.

measured.housesAfter360Ticks: 15 of 15 on either map in a probe with nobody playing

liveServerProof.note: Same computer only. PORT=8755 SEED=npc-proof PLAYERS=5 on the default (Gonzales) map; one student joined over HTTP; host set Quick pace and started. Read from the save at tick 154. Not a browser proof: nothing a student sees changed except the neighbours' own behaviour.
observed: world.neighbours true; hh-1 played true: house null, field bare, people working and resting as a student left them.

hh-2 to hh-5 played false: each a round-log house at 40 of 40 hours of work; hh-2 mending and harvesting, hh-3 fetching seed (all four at once - found, and capped), hh-4 planting and fetching seed, hh-5 field planted and selling cotton (three at once - capped).
Their stories: 'Trinidad set out: hunt in the timber.', 'Drusilla set out: plant the field.'

injectedRegressions: played families run too -> never-run test
it never builds -> living test, never-run test, raising test
seed given away before planting -> trade test
the last shot given away -> trade test
a refusal says nothing -> trade test
everybody hunts -> living test and never-run test
a whole family on one errand -> living test
joining does not mark the family -> HTTP join test
acts for the wrong family -> raising test
NOT CAUGHT: the world.neighbours check removed from advanceNeighbours alone, because automatic() checks it too; removing both is what would turn neighbours on in old classes.

notBuilt: Unasked help at a student's raising, neighbours making offers, a Host control to hand a family to the director, answering the war, exclusion from the ending (the ending is not built).
